scope: Target-only accuracy replay from identical captured KV values/strides. No draft, generation, prefill, cache-history rebuild or performance measurement. Bounded causal screening identifies contributors, not an automatic backend bug.

operator_probe.note: CPU FP64 is a numerical reference, not proof of correct rounding. A shape difference alone does not establish a backend bug. Inputs are restored contiguously; original trace strides are recorded separately.
